en: The postcard is a sepia-toned or black-and-white photograph depicting a large building complex, including a structure with a tower resembling a small castle or manor house, surrounded by trees and open land. The landscape is pastoral with a curved path leading towards the buildings. Printed at the bottom in ornate red script is the text 'Gruss aus Gauernitz.' The left edge has small vertical text reading '67 Brück & Sohn, Meißen.'
